snippet.title: Clean Up Earth Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A gameplay trailer for Clean Up Earth introduced viewers to this wholesome beach clean simulator where you can restore ecosystems with up to 25 friends in co-op. Better still, your virtual trash-picking contributes towards real-world recycling efforts. Clean Up Earth is coming soon to PC and consoles, with a demo available now on Steam.  

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402720/Clean_Up_Earth/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
